title: ServiceClass
description: A classification of the level of service offered by a transport service, such as economy, business, or first class. v2.1 adds isAirConditioned and airConditioningScore for V1 ONDC TRV10 VEHICLE_INFO round-trip.

serviceClassCode.description: Code identifying the service class (e.g. ECONOMY, BUSINESS, FIRST)

features.description: List of features and amenities included in this service class

id.description: Unique identifier for the category code

parentCategoryId.description: Identifier of the parent category if hierarchical

isAirConditioned.description: Whether vehicles in this service class are air conditioned. Maps to V1 fulfillment.tags[VEHICLE_INFO].IS_AIR_CONDITIONED_VEHICLE.

airConditioningScore.description: Numeric air conditioning quality rating for this service class. Maps to V1 fulfillment.tags[VEHICLE_INFO].IS_AIR_CONDITIONED value.
